issues.message: Not yet placed by a builder GameTest: cornflower, carved_pumpkin, candle.
413 blocks, over the common budget of 350 (docs/STRUCTURES.md). A warning only.

notes.detail: Adds a pumpkin-headed dummy with arms, a lantern post, flower boxes, campfire on the chimney and a red carpet aisle; the walls themselves are still bare.
notes.life: Flowers, lantern post and the dummy make the entrance lively.
notes.roof: Unchanged from L1: one flat spruce colour, untrimmed gables.

visual.summary: L1 plus a proper training dummy, flower boxes and a lantern at the door, a smoking chimney and a red carpet down the aisle; the entrance now has life.
problems: The two raised coarse-dirt flower boxes beside the door (front, y=0..1) read as raw dirt cubes: edge them with trapdoors or use a planter of spruce trapdoors/podzol.
Back wall and gables are still bare (see L1).
Reach: unchanged from L1; only roof slopes and dummy top unreached (fine).
